input: Renew the car registration before the deadline

gold.taskTitle: Renew Car Registration Before the Deadline
gold.taskDescription: The user needs to renew their vehicle's registration before the expiration deadline.

questions.title: What is the exact registration expiration date?
questions.description: Identify the specific deadline by which the renewal must be completed.

questions.title: Which state or country is the vehicle registered in?
questions.description: Determine the jurisdiction to identify the correct renewal process and authority.

questions.title: Have you received a renewal notice from the DMV?
questions.description: Check whether the official renewal notice or PIN needed for online renewal is already in hand.

questions.title: Do you plan to renew online, by mail, or in person?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred renewal method to tailor the steps accordingly.

questions.title: Is the vehicle due for a smog or safety inspection first?
questions.description: Determine if a mandatory inspection must be passed before the registration can be renewed.

questions.title: Are there any outstanding fees, tickets, or holds on the vehicle?
questions.description: Identify any blockers such as unpaid fines or tolls that could prevent renewal.

questions.title: What is your budget for the renewal fees?
questions.description: Understand the user's financial readiness to cover registration renewal costs.
